newsitem.title: USA: CAI Wireless named in shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: CAI Wireless named in shareholder suit.

text.p: CAI Wireless Systems Inc has been named in a class action alleging federal securities laws violations, attorneys representing plaintiffs said Wednesday.
The suit represents investors who bought CAI stock from May 23, 1996 to December 5, when CAI stock went from more than $13 per share to below $2, the attorneys said in a release.
The suit was filed by attorneys with Berger & Montague PC and Powers & Santola in the United States District Court for the Northern District of New York.

According to the release, the complaint alleges that CAI and two of its officials inflated the stock with misleading information about the company's Internet transmission product and a business relationship with Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp.
No one at the company was immediately available for comment.
